summary: Learn how to explore nearby Pandan chiffon cakes, kuih, and local bakeries with real-time distance and interactive map.

steps.title: Open Pandan Discovery Dashboard
steps.userInstruction: Launch the application in your browser. The system will detect your location and initialize the interactive food map.
steps.expectedOutcome: The hero header, 3D leaf backdrop, and interactive map container are displayed.
steps.notes: Ensure your device location services are turned on for accurate geodesic distance calculations.

steps.title: Explore Nearby Pandan Pins on Map
steps.userInstruction: Scan the interactive Google Map to view pins indicating verified Pandan culinary locations within walking distance.
steps.expectedOutcome: Map markers display rating badges (e.g. 4.8★) positioned at exact geodesic coordinates.
steps.notes: Each marker is filtered to exclude non-food businesses in townships named Pandan.

steps.title: Select a Spot for Detailed Information
steps.userInstruction: Click any green Pandan pin on the map to bring up the establishment card overlay.
steps.expectedOutcome: A floating card displays the food spot name, star rating, address, opening hours, and distance.

steps.title: Review Spot Details & Opening Hours
steps.userInstruction: Inspect the specialty highlights, rating badge, address, and live open status.
steps.expectedOutcome: Detailed info confirms business name, photo preview, and open status.
steps.notes: The badge tags top-tier chiffon cakes, authentic kuih, and waffles.

steps.title: Filter by Distance Radius and Rating
steps.userInstruction: Use the filter panel to select maximum walking distance (e.g., 1km, 3km, 5km) or filter by minimum rating.
steps.expectedOutcome: The map dynamically adjusts pins matching the updated filter preferences.

faqAndTroubleshooting.userMessage: No authentic Pandan spots found nearby
faqAndTroubleshooting.resolution: Expand search radius to 3km or 5km using the filter panel, or click "Try Again" after granting location permission.
